subject: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

Hi all,

Quick summary: Tom Parker on Orion resigned effective 3/31. Team needs a backfill for the Lead SWE role (IC5 scope) to avoid sprint drag. We have an internal candidate, Logan Wright (IC4 Senior SWE), who's expressed interest in an upward move + internal transfer with a targeted relevel to IC5. Recruiting is estimating 8–12 weeks for an external search.

Asking for: 1) provisional headcount approval to convert Tom's slot to a Lead SWE backfill, 2) permission to propose a relevel + transfer for Logan if People Ops and Finance sign off on comp, or otherwise open an external search.

Attachments: JD draft (orion-lead-swe-jd-v2.pdf), org chart; comp band sheet in case we need to propose salary.

Background context: Logan has been on Orion for 18 months, has led three cross-team features and is the natural interim owner. If we transfer Logan and relevel, we should be able to avoid a 2-3 sprint velocity hit and reduce ramp time. If we pursue external, Monica: please confirm timeline and candidate funnel.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus: confirm you want to keep role as Lead SWE (vs splitting into IC4+manager mix)
- Maya + Aditya: confirm there's budget headroom in Q2 for a promoted comp band if we relevel Logan
- Monica: prep external search brief as contingency

Thanks — can we align by EOD Tue 3/24?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Engineering Manager, Orion
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: orion-lead-swe-jd-v2.pdf (10 pages, PDF), org-chart-q1-2026.png (image), comp-band-ic4-ic5-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

Eve — thanks for the heads up. My preference is to keep a single Lead SWE on Orion (no split) given the feature roadmap for Q2. An internal transfer that preserves momentum is attractive. A few constraints / questions:

1) Compensation: if we relevel Logan to IC5, what's the delta we need vs his current comp (base + target bonus + equity)? I need a clear number to sign off.
2) Backfill timeline risk: if Logan moves, we still need to backfill his IC4 seat (likely harder to backfill mid-quarter). Monica, what's realistic turnaround to fill an IC4 from internal pool vs external?

If Finance can absorb the delta and Paula in Legal has no objections on title changes, I support the internal move.

-Markus
Marcus Lin
Director of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

Thanks for looping me in. Quick notes from TA:

- External search timeline: with a targeted sourcer and active outreach + 1-2 strong pipeline partners (TalentBridge included), realistic time-to-offer is 8–10 weeks. To get an offer accepted by Q2 end we'd need to open by 3/29.
- Internal transfer: filling Logan's IC4 seat internally is usually 3–6 weeks if we reprioritize internal mobility + internal referrals; external will be longer.
- Salary bands: I reviewed the comp-band file you attached. If we relevel Logan to IC5, he lands near the 35th percentile for IC5 given current market; we can propose a midpoint increase + retention equity to sweeten.

I can draft the external req tonight and a contingency internal mobility plan. If you want me to kick TalentBridge, I can do that but will wait for sign-off.

Monica Patel
Talent Partner, Recruiting
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: external-search-brief.txt (1 page stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

Evelyn/Marcus — quick finance take. I pulled Logan's current comp and the comp-band file. Numbers (rounded):
- Logan current cash comp (base + target bonus): $185k
- Target IC5 midpoint for region: $235k
- Delta: ~$50k cash; equity/one-time retention grant likely required to keep comp competitive (estimate $25k–$40k FY value).

We have some Q2 budget headroom but not for permanent increases above $40k without offsetting savings. Options:
A) Approve a provisional uplift to $210k base + 12-month retention equity (one-time grant) — needs exec sign for promotion budget; or
B) Approve temporary level-of-responsibility bump (title change + temporary stipend) while we plan on filling the IC4 hole externally next quarter (saves permanent budget this quarter).

If you lean internal, recommend option A with a doc that ties the uplift to measurable deliverables (feature milestones) and a follow-up comp review in 6 months. I can draft numbers for the approval doc.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

Appreciate the conversation and the consideration. A few points from my side:
- I'm open to taking the Lead SWE role and understand the expectation that it's an IC5 scope. I want clarity up front on comp and title (don't want to be in a prolonged interim state).
- I accept a performance-based uplift plan (deliverables + 6-month review) but would prefer an equity retention grant to offset the step change.
- If we commit to the internal move, I'd like TA to document the timeline for filling my IC4 seat so my team isn't over-indexed.

Happy to sync 30m today if useful.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Software Engineer (IC4) — Orion
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill approval: Lead SWE (team Orion) — internal transfer (Logan) vs external hire

All — following up with People Ops recommendations so you can greenlight:

1) Approved approach: Internal transfer + relevel to IC5 with a one-time retention equity grant ($30k value) + base uplift to $215k (documented as promotion effective 4/6) conditional on the feature milestones Marcus listed (deliverables doc linked).
2) Contingency: If Finance cannot finalize budget, we do a title/resp bump with a 6-month review and temporary stipend of $10k, then re-evaluate Q3.
3) TA plan: Monica to open an IC4 internal mobility req immediately and start external funnel week of 3/29 if internal pipeline insufficient. Estimated time-to-fill: 3–6 weeks internal, 8–10 external.

If Marcus and Aditya confirm, I will prepare the official promotion paperwork and update Workday with the effective date. Please reply ALL with sign-off by EOD.

Maya Srinivasan
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
